## chat-orchestration

Implements the `N8N_WEBHOOK_URL` contract `backend/apps/chat-bot-service/src/n8n/n8n.client.ts` calls.

**"Mock RAG (placeholder)"** stands in for a real S3 Vectors query (`infra/terraform/modules/ai_data`) — nothing locally has a populated vector index, so it returns a fixed string instead. Swap that one node for a real retrieval node once the index has data; nothing else in this workflow needs to change, since `context` already flows through to llm-service either way.

See `langchain_rag/n8n/README.md` for how to run and test this locally.
